tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Design, Manufacture, Testing and Supply of Control Cables of the size 19CoreX2.5Sqmm required for various sub-stations coming under Transmission Operations Zone Mysuru conforming to Technical Specifications. F.O.R.D at Store basis, including insurance, transportation and unloading.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Transmission Zone Office Mysuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All original scanned copies of the documents mentioned above shall be uploaded and if required, same shall be produced for verification.

The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or Partnership firm or Private firm or Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013.Note: For other than proprietorship, the Bidder shall furnish the registered partnership deed and Power of Attorney.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) registration and PAN No issued by the Board of Direct Taxes under the Income Tax Act, 1961. The same shall upload the necessary supporting document to establish compliance for having GST registration.

The bidder shall have a minimum experience of Five years in the field of in Designing, Manufacturing, Testing & Supply of tendered materials. (Bidders shall have to upload the supporting Documents such as Purchase orders, issued by State /Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase Order Copies, Not below Five Years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The liquid assets & availability of credit facilities of no less than 30% of the requirement(Credit lines/letter of credit/certificated from banks for meeting the funds requirements etc.,(usually the equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 03 months in peak construction period) i.es Rs. 16,63,435.00 as on Aug-2026 as per Annexure.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- liquid assets & availability of credit facilities as per the annexure

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have manufactured at least 80% of the quantity of Tendered material/equipment. (Bidders have to furnish the supporting Documents such as P.O). The Bidder shall furnish the Performance Certificates for at least 30% of the tendered materials and the performance certificates should have been issued by the State/Central owned Electricity utilities / Generating utilities only, and issuing officer shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent division head. In the Performance Certificate, the equipment of tendered material should be in successful operation for at least two years as on the date of bid opening. The performance certificate shall be indicating the capacity, make, name of the sub-Division where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that tendered materials/equipments of this bid were in successful operation for at least TWO years as on the date of bid opening

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase Orders- 80percent as supporting documents
Others -- Performance Certificates- 30percent as supporting documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Note:KPTCL may conduct type tests as per relevant standards at its cost on a random sample of Tendered material /equipment specified in the present enquiry at any point of time during the contract at CPRI/ERDA Laboratory. In support, Companys Certificate of Incorporation/ Memorandum of Association/ Article of Association of the company in case of Registered Companies under companies act/ Partnership deed in case of Partnership Firm, Registration Certificate of establishment, GoK.

The Bidder shall furnish type test certificates not older than (10years) Ten years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful type test at CPRI/ERDA NABL accredited Laboratory test house as per the relevant IS/IEC standards on the equipment/material specified in the bid. Bidders shall have to upload the type test certificates of the material/equipment specified in the present enquiry as per the relevant IS/IEC standards.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should provide bid validity for 180 days from the date of opening of the bid on Rs.100/- stamp paper as per format.
If part or full price sheets or prices are exposed in the Techno-Commercial Sheets or Techno-Commercial Bid of the Bidder then, the offer of the Bidder will be rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The offer of the Tenderer taking deviations in following clauses will be summarily rejected. Validity of offer, Earnest Money Deposit/ Bid Security, Performance Security/Contract Performance Guarantee,Payment terms. Guarantee/Warrantee,Liquidated Damages/Penalty for delay in supplies,Stipulated Delivery Schedule, Price Basis,Type Tests, Change in offered quantity against tendered quantity.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any Tenderer/ Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section XVI of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/ Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer/ Bidder in the following format i)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India, I certify that this Tenderer/Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Tenderer/ Bidder, fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached/uploaded.ii) I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/vendor does not have any ToT arrangement requiring registration with the competent authority OR I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder/ vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/ Bidder/ vendor has valid registration to participate in this procurement. Self declaration in the prescribed format shall be uploaded.
